page_title: BAY 8-1 MAI | Bayern Munich v Mainz 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' 8 - 1 Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
90+1' A quickly taken corner by Bayern Munich.
90+1' Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
88' The current number of shots on goal is 11:3.
85' Bayern Munich enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
84' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
80' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
80' Now Mainz have a corner.

79' Marco Richter (Mainz) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Mainz have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
77' Mainz take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
77' Marco Richter (Mainz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and Mainz manage to earn a corner.
76' A substitution has been made. Tom Krauss goes off and Danny da Costa (Mainz) comes on.
76' Substitution. Brajan Gruda makes way for Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz).
75' Thomas Tuchel decides to make a substitution. Jamal Musiala will be replaced by Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich).
75' Eric Dier will be replaced by Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich).
74' The linesman raises his flag. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is adjudged offside.
70' 7 - 1 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets to the rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the right post and makes it 7:1.
70' Wait! Referee Patrick Ittrich immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
70' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
70' The referee awards a corner and Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) goes over to take it.

69' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will have a chance to score from a corner.
69' Bayern Munich are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
66' 6 - 1 What a goal! Leon Goretzka swings a cross into the box and Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) scores a magnificent back-heel goal! 6:1.
65' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Jonathan Burkardt is replaced by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz).
65' It will be a substitution. Marco Richter (Mainz) is ready to enter the pitch as Jae-Sung Lee walks off.

65' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Robin Zentner shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
64' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

64' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' Substitution. Thomas Muller walks off the pitch and Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) comes on as a substitute.
62' Thomas Tuchel has decided to substitute Leroy Sane and he is replaced by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
61' 5 - 1 It's 5:1! Harry Kane feeds Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.

61' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
60' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

60' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Mainz.
59' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

59' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Mainz will have an opportunity.
58' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) works the corner short.

58' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Mainz force their opponents to concede a corner.
58' Neat passing move from Mainz in order to create new attacking opportunities.

55' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Brajan Gruda (Mainz), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
54' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
51' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) causes Manuel Neuer little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
50' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mainz.
47' 4 - 1 Goal! Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) takes a short pass from Jamal Musiala in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 4:1.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+7' 3 - 1 Leon Goretzka sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches on to it and finishes with a quick low shot into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 3:1.
45+7' Bayern Munich control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
45+4' Bayern Munich take a short corner kick.
45+4' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) produces a clever header from around the penalty spot, but it's stopped by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich win a corner kick.
45+3' Anthony Caci (Mainz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Patrick Ittrich blows for a foul. Bayern Munich win a free kick.

45+2' The opposition can't get near Brajan Gruda (Mainz), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just over the bar at the last second. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
45+1' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) plays a lovely through ball to Leroy Sane, but he can't beat Robin Zentner and loses the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
45' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the top left corner, but Robin Zentner keeps it out with an amazing save.
44' Corner kicks – 2:2.
41' Mainz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
37' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
36' An attempted cross from Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is cleared. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
35' Josuha Guilavogui (Mainz) is substituted due to injury. Bo Henriksen gives a chance to Edimilson Fernandes.
33' The game is interrupted. Josuha Guilavogui (Mainz) suffers a horrific injury!

31' 2 - 1 Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the top left corner.
31' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich). Patrick Ittrich saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Mainz are awarded a free kick.
30' The Bayern Munich players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Patrick Ittrich. NO PENALTY!
29' Celebrations by Bayern Munich are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
28' The referee blows his whistle after Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is going to take the penalty!

27' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
24' The Mainz players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
19' 2 - 0 Goal! Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:0.
19' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a decent header which rattles the left post!
18' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
18' Thomas Tuchel is forced to make a change. Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) is unable to continue due to injury, Raphael Guerreiro comes on.
18' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
15' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

14' Robin Zentner was forced into action to thwart Harry Kane (Bayern Munich). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Jamal Musiala finds Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
12' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
12' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Mainz earn a corner.
11' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) offside.
9' Wonderful movement by Bayern Munich. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
7' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robin Zentner intercepts the ball.
5' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
5' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

2' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
2' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman makes the right call and Bayern Munich will have a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Mainz will kick the game off.
Patrick Ittrich will officiate today.
